newsitem.title: ROMANIA: TURNOVER FALLS ON ROMANIA'S OTC MARKET.
newsitem.headline: TURNOVER FALLS ON ROMANIA'S OTC MARKET.

text.p: Turnover on Romania's over-the-counter market fell to some 20 billion lei on this week's five trading days from around 21.5 billion last week but operators said trading had been active.
They said the buying mood had remained strong, pushing up prices.
Cement maker Casial was the most heavily traded stock, ending 30 lei firmer on the week at 890.
"Casial, this week's star, might remain at centre-stage next week too," one trader said.
High-cap cement maker Romcim, which once dominated trading, was in high demand but traders said with major share packages already sold supply was thin. Romcim closed 2,900 lei stronger at 41,600.
More than 11 million shares changed hands in the week on the RASDAQ -- the Romanian OTC system modelled on the U.S. NASDAQ. Last week the system traded 13.1 million shares.
The independent VAB-RASDAQ index, computed by VANGUARD securities, rose 114 points on the week to 2,039.
The RASDAQ opened last October and now lists 2,714 stocks. It traded an average 400 companies per session this week.
